# [PR #3227] [Runtime] Fix library loading for symlink installs

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/3227
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-15T16:25:01Z
labels: 

## 正文

Reuse Windows dependency discovery on POSIX to resolve Z3 under symlink installs.
Fixes #3075.
Tested: uv symlink/copy installs and CUDA vector addition.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary

- Added cross-platform discovery of `tvm_ffi` and Z3 runtime library directories.
- Preloads Z3 globally on POSIX systems to support symlink-based installations.
- Preserved Windows DLL search-path handling.
- Validated with `uv` symlink and copy installations and CUDA vector addition.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

> 
> `601-612`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_
> 
> **Include both Z3 library directories in `get_runtime_library_dirs`.** `FindZ3.cmake` searches `${Z3_PATH}/bin` and `${Z3_PATH}/lib`, so supported Z3 installations can use either directory. TileLang enables Z3 for native optimizations, and heavy imports preload only the fixed Z3 filename from directories returned by this helper before loading the native library. A `bin`-only installation is skipped and can cause the native import to fail with an unresolved Z3 dependency. Return both existing directories from the shared helper.
>
